$comment: A LoRa radio wired straight to this host over a serial port — the point-to-point half of LoRa, for a link with no network server at all. If your traffic arrives through ChirpStack or The Things Stack, use examples/connectors/lorawan.json instead: it needs no radio on this machine and no extra dependency. The module families here share no command syntax, so a dialect is a receive regex plus a send template rather than a driver; `dialect: "custom"` with your own regex is what makes a module nobody here has heard of work. Needs `pip install -r requirements-lora.txt`.

devices.$comment: Routed by fPort, because every frame from the radio arrives on one stream and there is no topic to route by. A device may also select on `address` — matched against the dialect's (?P<address>...) group, or against the leading payload bytes when the dialect exposes none, since a raw point-to-point link has no MAC addressing and who sent a frame can only be inside the frame.
devices.name: remote_meter
